title: release.sh reports a publish FAILED when GitHub's jobs API returns HTTP 500
detail: 0.270.0 release: '[release] watch publish run 44944316054' then 'failed to get jobs: HTTP 500 (api.github.com/.../runs/44944316054/jobs)' and '[release] FAILED: publish run 44944316054 failed'. The run had succeeded: the resume watched the same run green and installed. An unreadable run is not a failed run: retry the read, and when it stays unreadable say the state is unknown, never FAILED.
